title: Closed native Float64 core arithmetic and typed compositional workflows

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name declarations only, including aliases and limited signatures; not complete GEE or project migration compatibility.

implementation.typed_lowering: At least one typed Double operand routes core operations to the bounded native path before Float32 callbacks. Existing Float32 graphs retain their path; proven Boolean outputs alone may use Float32 callbacks. Integer/QA outputs can continue arithmetic without toFloat. Existing clamp/unitScale/normalizedDifference/expression/hypot lowerings reuse closed primitives.
implementation.values: Finite source binary64 operands, source NaN masks, source infinities reject. Each operation stages binary64 with per-used-operand mask intersection; invalid-domain and nonfinite results become NaN NoData. Finite underflow remains valid. Physical output Double NaN; no Google dtype propagation guarantee.
implementation.local_policies: divide by either signed zero yields positive zero, including0/0. mod uses signed truncated-quotient remainder, zero divisor masks. round ties toward positive infinity via stable floor/fraction without perturbing large integral values. Transcendentals/power use StrictMath; no Google bit/ULP parity claim.
implementation.constants: Typed constant folds retain Double and preserve explicit nested toFloat rounding. Bound constant arithmetic applies actual cast boundaries and preserves existing finite source/grid, exact-domain +/-2^53, cycle and budget checks. Source-free masked typed constants and standalone global constant rasters remain explicit rejections.
implementation.wire: Historical local_ee_integer_values v1 strict canonical JSON and existing one/two contiguous-band contract, independently validated in Python and Scala; no new generic evaluator or user-code execution.

resources.policy: Existing conservative4-work copy charge per input retained; operation weights32 for transcendental/power,4 for divide/mod/round/floor/ceil,1 for other core operations. Actual native decoded/output charges remain. Admission is not throughput/RSS evidence.

warnings.scope: Existing lifecycle/deprecation notices; no dependency/interpreter upgrade or new security advisory scan.

official_clients.map_export: Offline request capture only; no running service, physical raster export or real temperature sample. synthetic_temperature_millikelvin is test metadata with mK/0.001/0; not an existing provider-data claim.

native_float64.scope: Actual GeoTrellis tiles through direct and historical-dispatcher Float64 kernels; no SparkContext, provider service, user data, VM, or container

native_integer_regression.scope: Actual GeoTrellis tiles through LocalEeIntegerValuesNumeric.applyTile; no SparkContext, service, sandbox task, VM, container, or user data

sample_graph_numerics.scope: Independent NumPy SPI handler in existing sample-vector graph interpreter; separate from actual native primitive kernels and not full Spark raster execution.
sample_graph_numerics.fixed_array: Two-element fixed-shape add/subtract/multiply/divide, two native scalar nodes each; exact NumPy match including2^24+1, whole-array masks, zero-divisor behavior, names/properties/sourceIDs, no toFloat.
sample_graph_numerics.regression: Aligned three-observation single-predictor through-origin coefficient graph compared with exact Fraction input reference at rtol=atol=2e-15, including missing observations, outside-source geometry and zero norm.
sample_graph_numerics.retained_limits: Missing projection/grid evidence rejects. Same three-frame Double residual graph rejects with existing compilation-limits error; no cap raised and no residual numerical claim.

initial_regression.resolution: Two former blanket Float64 rejection expectations became obsolete. Fixed arrays and coefficient subset received independent numerical proofs; missing-grid negative retained, residual budget rejection asserted. No blanket weakening or fabricated raster values. Initial XML/log/hashes retained separately.

original_probes.scope: Original fixed50 expressions, not representative full-API coverage.

adapter.build_warnings: Existing image-sample outer-reference warning and9 Scala deprecations, two warning groups.
